claims: The 98th Academy Awards air live on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The 98th Academy Awards air at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT.
Conan O'Brien hosts the 98th Academy Awards.
The 98th Academy Awards are at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles.
Red Carpet coverage starts at 3:30 p.m. ET/12:30 p.m. PT on ABC and Hulu.
The TV channel for the 2026 Oscars is ABC.
One Battle After Another led with 13 nominations for the 2026 Oscars.
Michael B. Jordan has acting wins for Sinners.
Jessie Buckley has acting wins for Hamnet.
Highlights and replays are available on Hulu and ABC.com the following day.
